tweets.text:
Conference organizers, you know what to do.

Cancel any event in a state that restricts women’s rights. You can’t guarantee the safety of people who travel to your event.

When chatting with a new team, I sometimes use this type of approach to do a spot, collaborative assessment.

I've found that people are open to the discussion when you present enough angles and nuance.
a company culture is often defined by the most widely known thing that can't be said out loud
"we need RACI" almost always indicates that someone hasn't untangled what is actually happening

Leader:

“You know you’ve lost when someone doesn’t think it is worth saying something to you. It almost doesn’t matter what that thing is”

Wow.
